Package org.cyborgcats.componentViz

Class ComponentVizRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.subsystem.Subsystem
org.cyborgcats.componentViz.ComponentVizRegistry
public class ComponentVizRegistry extends Subsystem
Global registry that collects ComponentViz instances, sorts them by render order, and publishes their poses to AdvantageKit each loop iteration.

    • register

      public static void register(ComponentViz viz)
      Registers a ComponentViz instance to be included in the next build() call.

      viz - the component visualization to register

    • build

      public static void build()
      Sorts all registered components by their render order and caches their pose suppliers. Must be called once after all components are registered (e.g., in robotInit).

    • periodic

      public void periodic()
      Evaluates all cached pose suppliers and logs the resulting array to AdvantageKit under "ComponentViz/Poses". Should be called every robot loop iteration.
